Name: Mahlon, Son of Elimelech
Summary: Mahlon, son of Elimelech and Naomi, died in Moab after marrying Ruth; his widow's marriage to Boaz restored his family's name and land.
KeyStory: Mahlon went with his family to Moab in the famine, married Ruth, and died there, leaving his mother a widow and his name to be raised up by Boaz.
RelatedPeople: Elimelech; Naomi; Ruth; Chilion, Son of Elimelech
LifeLesson: A man who died young in a foreign field lived on through the kinsman who married his widow.
